# Spravek Reserve

> A curated fleet of luxury vehicles in Utah, released by allocation and
> delivered to the client. Mercedes-AMG SL 63 S E Performance, Mercedes-Benz
> S 580 (self-drive or chauffeured), and Ford F-350 Platinum Plus Dually.

## About

Spravek Reserve is a DBA of Relentless Equipment LLC and part of the Spravek
family of Utah companies. The fleet is owned, detailed, insured commercially,
and delivered by hand along the Wasatch Front, to Park City / Deer Valley, and
to Salt Lake City International Airport. Bookings are called "allocations"
and are confirmed personally within one business day.

- Region: Utah — Wasatch Front, Park City, SLC airport
- Price tier: luxury ($$$$), quoted by allocation
- Contact: see /allocation

## The Fleet

- The Roadster — Mercedes-AMG SL 63 S E Performance (805 hp plug-in hybrid roadster; weddings, anniversaries, canyon drives)
- The Arrival — Mercedes-Benz S 580 4MATIC (flagship sedan; self-drive or chauffeured; airport, Park City, client dinners, weddings)
- The Statement — Ford F-350 Platinum Plus Dually (6.7L High Output Power Stroke; boats, horse trailers, toy haulers)
